lines.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
You showed favor to Your land, O LORD;
You forgave the iniquity of Your people;
You turned from Your burning anger.
Restore us, O God of our salvation,
and put away Your displeasure toward us.
Will You be angry with us forever?
Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?
Will You not revive us again,
that Your people may rejoice in You?
Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD,

pictures.scene: Paul Joseph Constantin Gabriël, Een molen aan een poldervaart, bekend als 'In de maand juli' — the green polder lying quiet under a wide summer sky, for the choirmaster a Psalm of the sons of Korah, You showed favor to Your land O LORD
pictures.name: pd_gabriel_juli

pictures.scene: Jacopo Bassano, Jacob's Journey — the whole household moving home again with its flocks and children, You restored Jacob from captivity, You forgave the iniquity of Your people
pictures.name: pd_bassano_jacob

pictures.scene: Gijsbrecht Leytens, Winter landscape — the new snow laid clean over everything the land had been, You covered all their sin
pictures.name: pd_leytens_winter

pictures.scene: Salvator Rosa, Jonah Preaching to the People of Niniveh — the warned city given its reprieve, You withheld all Your fury, You turned from Your burning anger
pictures.name: pd_rosa_jona

pictures.scene: Nikolay Bogdanov-Belsky, At School Doors — the ragged boy waiting at the threshold to be let in, restore us O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us
pictures.name: pd_bogdanov_schooldeur

pictures.scene: Fyodor Vasilyev, Before the Storm — the lone traveller under a sky that has not broken yet, will You be angry with us forever, will You draw out Your anger to all generations
pictures.name: pd_vasilyev_pered_grozoy

pictures.scene: Camille Pissarro, Orchard in Bloom Louveciennes — the old trees breaking into blossom again, will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You
pictures.name: pd_pissarro_verger

pictures.scene: Jacob Simon Hendrik Kever, Moeders kroost — the mother with her small children gathered close about her, show us Your loving devotion O LORD, and grant us Your salvation
pictures.name: pd_kever_moeders_kroost
